children.name: Pyxidanthera
children.description: Pyxidanthera — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Pyxidanthera barbulata Michx.
children.description: Pyxidanthera barbulata, the flowering pixiemoss, is a species of flowering plant in the family Diapensiaceae.

children.name: Pyxidanthera brevifolia Wells
children.description: Pyxidanthera brevifolia, the littleleaf pixiemoss or sandhills pyxie-moss, is a plant species known only from North Carolina and South Carolina.

children.name: Schizocodon
children.description: Schizocodon — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Schizocodon ilicifolius Maxim.
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan (Honshu, Yakushima). It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Schizocodon soldanelloides Siebold & Zucc.
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Schizocodon yunnanensis T.Yamaz.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (Yunnan). It grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Berneuxia
children.description: Berneuxia — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Berneuxia thibetica Decne.
children.description: The native range of this species is Arunachal Pradesh to China (Sichuan, N. Yunnan, NW. Guizhou). It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Diapensia
children.description: Diapensia — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Diapensia albida  J.F.Ye
children.description: The native range of this species is China (W. Sichuan, NW. Yunnan). It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Diapensia himalaica Hook.fil. & Thomson
children.description: The native range of this species is E. Nepal to China (NW. Yunnan) and N. Myanmar. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Diapensia lapponica L.
children.description: Diapensia lapponica, the pincushion plant, is a plant in the family Diapensiaceae, the only circumboreal species in the genus Diapensia, the others being mainly in the Himalaya and on mountains in southwestern China.

children.name: Diapensia obovata  Nakai
children.description: The native range of this species is C. Siberia to N. & C. Japan, Alaska to N. British Columbia. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Diapensia purpurea Diels
children.description: The native range of this species is Sikkim to China (W. Sichuan, NW. Yunnan) and N. Myanmar. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Diapensia wardii W.E.Evans
children.description: The native range of this species is SE. Tibet. It is a subshrub and grows primarily in the subalpine or subarctic biome.

children.name: Galax
children.description: Galax — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Galax urceolata  Brummitt
children.description: The native range of this species is Ohio to SE. U.S.A.. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Shortia
children.description: Shortia — a genus of magnoliopsidas.

children.name: Shortia brevistyla  Gaddy
children.description: The native range of this species is North Carolina (McDowell Co.). It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Shortia galacifolia Torr. & A.Gray
children.description: Shortia galacifolia, the Oconee bell is a rare North American plant in the family Diapensiaceae found in the southern Appalachian Mountains, concentrated in the tri-state border region of Georgia, North Carolina, and South Carolina.

children.name: Shortia rotata Gaddy & Nuraliev
children.description: The native range of this species is Vietnam. It grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Shortia rotundifolia  Makino
children.description: The native range of this species is Nansei-shotō to Taiwan. It is a perennial or rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.

children.name: Shortia sinensis Hemsl.
children.description: The native range of this species is China (SE. Yunnan) to N. Vietnam. It is a perennial and grows primarily in the subtropical biome.

children.name: Shortia uniflora  Maxim.
children.description: The native range of this species is Japan. It is a rhizomatous geophyte and grows primarily in the temperate biome.
